# Janet

## Overview

- **Age:** forty  <sub>[v3 ch.Last P51](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0051)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Janet features a sunny face with rosy cheeks and large, kind eyes that are as blue as forget-me-nots. Her soft, crimpy brown hair contains a single thread of gray and is worn styled in a knot.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)_

## History

Janet Sweet, who lost her sister [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when she was young, worked as a pleasant landlady at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), where she befriended her boarder [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After twenty years of silent courtship from her admirer [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), Janet took Anne's advice to take a firm stand and sharply rejected his escort after a prayer meeting, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly rushed to reconcile the pair. Following the eventual death of John's mother, John proposed to Janet, revealing he had been bound by a promise to his mother to wait until after her passing before marrying or telling anyone.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P2](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0002), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009), [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), +11 more_

## Quotes

> "If she wasn’t—but she is. So we mustn’t speak evil of her. But I’m happy at last, Anne. And I wouldn’t have minded waiting so long a bit if I’d only known why."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Last P47](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0047)

> "Oh, she does. She’s told me time and again that she’d love to see John settled before her time comes. She’s always giving him hints—you heard her yourself the other day. I thought I’d ha’ gone through the floor."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P10](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0010)

> “I couldn’t,” said poor Janet pathetically. “You see, Anne, I’ve always been awful fond of John. He might just as well keep coming as not, for there was never anybody else I’d want, so it didn’t matter.”
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)

> "No, I guess not. I was afraid to try, anyway, for fear he’d think I meant it and just go. I suppose I’m a poor-spirited creature, but that is how I feel. And I can’t help it."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P16](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0016)

> “I dunno,” said Janet hopelessly. “I dunno if I could ever get up enough spunk. Things have drifted so long. But I’ll think it over.”
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P18](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0018)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--janet.md)

Janet serves as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's landlady at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), and the two quickly become close friends and confidantes. Janet tearfully confides her long-standing romantic troubles to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who encourages her to take a stand, and the two later laugh together over a local boy's rejected proposal to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After the resolution of her situation, Janet shares the news of her upcoming marriage with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P2](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0002), +11 more_

- Friend of — friend and confidante who shares news of her upcoming marriage  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P2](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0002), [v3 ch.Last P45](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0045)</sub>

### [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/janet--john-douglas.md)

[John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) is Janet's long-time suitor who visited her regularly for twenty years without proposing. Their relationship suffered tension due to his silence, leading Janet to briefly reject his escort at Anne's suggestion. However, John finally proposes after his mother passes away, explaining that his mother had forced him to promise to wait until her death before marrying or revealing the arrangement.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P8](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0008), +10 more_

- Romantically involved with — courting / beau  <sub>[v3 ch.Douglas P8](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0008), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)</sub>
